Record Class ReportWindow

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.leap.leaplaughlove.reporting.analyst.ReportWindow
Record Components:
firstMonth - the first month in the window
lastMonth - the last month in the window
public record ReportWindow(YearMonth firstMonth, YearMonth lastMonth) extends Record
The run of whole UTC months a report covers, first to last inclusive.
